findings.highlight: As long the boy is back safe
findings.evidenceJa: 少年さえ無事でいるのなら
findings.governingReading: The English sets a condition of the boy returning safe.
findings.explanation: As long omits its second as.

findings.governingReading: 額に手を当てる tests the heat at her forehead after a chill.
findings.explanation: Touching her forehead becomes touching her cheek.

findings.highlight: covered muscles trained every day without rest
findings.evidenceJa: 鍛えられた筋肉は無駄がなく
findings.governingReading: The English describes trained muscles covering his body.

findings.highlight: She brings her face and hands in, trying to ball up the warmth heating her body.
findings.evidenceJa: 顔を、指を、身体を熱くする熱に沈む
findings.governingReading: 熱に沈む describes being immersed in the heat affecting face, fingers and body.
findings.explanation: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.

findings.evidenceJa: 奪い返したという事実
findings.governingReading: 奪い返した is taking back, with no expressed object or source-person in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.

findings.highlight: wanting to waste his efforts to protect her.
findings.evidenceJa: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい
findings.governingReading: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい makes pleasure the goal, even if his protective efforts are made futile.
findings.explanation: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.

findings.highlight: Her guilty conscience awakened a fever that was somehow like arousal.
findings.evidenceJa: 自責の念が、どこか昂奮に似た熱を覚ましていった
findings.governingReading: 熱を覚まして is cooling here, fixed by preceding25 cooling through contrition and the immediate26 next line saying 熱が冷めても.
findings.explanation: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.

findings.highlight: If I hurt you so you can't walk anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば
findings.governingReading: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば imagines him being disabled as the solution but does not explicitly name who inflicts the injury.
findings.explanation: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.

findings.highlight: Yeah. If I hurt you so you can't walk anymore, then you won't get into any danger, Senpai.
findings.evidenceJa: うん。歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば
findings.governingReading: Japanese encloses the direct-address utterance, followed by narration saying she murmured as if addressing him.
findings.explanation: The final spoken fantasy loses quotation marks.
